top_signals.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 26
top_signals.summary: Oil fluctuated as more barrels appeared to flow from inside the Persian Gulf, while traders awaited news from negotiations between Iran and Oman on a potential deal to resume shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

top_signals.title: Ocean rate concerns as orders for new container ships near 40% of global fleet
top_signals.summary:
Orders for new containerships have expanded to nearly 40% of the active fleet, driven by contracts for large vessels.

top_signals.title: Abercrombie Soars on Guidance Lift, Flagship Brand Growth
top_signals.summary: Abercrombie & Fitch Co. shares rallied after revenue topped estimates and the retailer raised its annual earnings guidance, suggesting the preppy apparel company is regaining some momentum even after another quarter of slow sales growth. Bloomberg's Mary Ross Gilbert joined Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss their earnings. (Source: Bloomberg)
